description: This file defines a 'FrameFilter' class, which is a subclass of 'FrameProcessor'. It implements filtering logic for frames in the Pipecat framework, allowing only specified frame types or system/end frames to pass through.

classes.name: FrameFilter
classes.description: A frame processor that filters frames based on their types, acting as a gate in the pipeline to allow only specified frames or system/end frames to pass through.

methods.name: __init__(self, types: Tuple[Type[Frame], ...])
methods.description: Initializes the FrameFilter with a tuple of frame types to allow through the filter.

methods.name: _should_passthrough_frame(self, frame)
methods.description: Determines if a frame should pass through the filter based on its type.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Asynchronously processes a frame, passing it through if it meets filter criteria.

ctags.name: process_frame
ctags.pattern: /^    async def process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection):$/
